messages.subject: RE: Project Harbor - SPA (our counter)
messages.plaintextBody:
Jonathan,

Our counter attached. We've moved to a 20% cap (£7.58m) - that's our final position on the cap and reflects the 10% retention and the earn-out. De minimis £45k, basket £500k. We accept 18 months on the general warranties but tax must stay at 7 years. The non-compete returns to 3 years given Geoffrey's continued involvement. Earn-out threshold £5.4m. I think this is very close now.

James

--
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.

messages.subject: RE: Project Harbor - SPA (our counter)
messages.plaintextBody:
James,

The Tindales accept the 20% cap, the £45k/£500k thresholds and 18 months on the general warranties. They'll live with 7 years on tax. On the non-compete they accept 3 years on the basis that Geoffrey's service agreement is finalised in parallel. I think we are agreed in principle - let's move to a clean execution version and disclosure.

Jonathan
